title: Foundations
coreMove: Design the beginning as if early structure will become expensive to change.
sourcePressure: The chapter treats the founding moment as unusually consequential because early roles, ownership, incentives, and relationships harden into the company shape. The frozen source for this chapter contains no chapter-specific named anecdote beyond author/editor metadata, so examples should use fictional protagonists and stay anchored to verified terms.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Reducing foundations to legal paperwork or startup housekeeping.

rhythmVariety.deepReadParagraphLengthMix: at least one paragraph 3 sentences or shorter, at least one paragraph 5+ sentences, at least one one-sentence punch line
